text: The clinic is very beautiful and clean. There's a storybook corner for children to read while waiting in line. Dr. Paeng is lovely, kind, gentle, and provides excellent advice, recommendations, and answers all of the mothers' questions. All the staff at the clinic are cheerful and friendly.

text:
The staff and doctors were all excellent.
The place is nicely decorated with lots of toys that the kids loved.
The waiting area is spacious, comfortable, and clean.
My child even said, "This is our favorite doctor's office!"

text: Guaranteed gentle and calm touch from the doctor! Adults can also come for check-ups and vaccinations. The clinic is clean, located on a main road, easy to find, and has easy parking.

I went because my two-month-old baby had wheezing and was worried about pneumonia. The doctor gave me excellent advice.
It relieved my anxiety and the treatment cost was reasonable.
